name: Cinderella
source: A girl who is a year older than [url=/c91602]Jack[/url], and who hasn't been able to attend high school at all due to unfortunate circumstances. With the help of Jack and his friends, they let her stay at the warehouse inside the school, which lets Cinderella feel the atmosphere of a school. Though she is pessimistic, she has very fast legs and is able to run away from both the guards and security cameras easily.
